description: Officers of a Czech company from the official public register open data (ISVR, Ministry of Justice, dataor.justice.cz, daily snapshot): statutory body, board of directors, supervisory board, control and arbitration commissions, prokura and liquidators, in force. Legal persons are NAMED with their IČO (or foreign id and country), with the published function and the number of natural persons representing them. Natural persons are COUNTED per body and role (closed list: president, vice_president, membre, gerant, non_precise, autre), never named, with no date or identity (GDPR, rule R1): most Czech boards hold natural persons only, and that answer is still served and billed. A legal person's name covered by an objection (GDPR art. 21) is served as null and counted in ecartes.opposition; a company whose own name is covered returns the same 404 as an unknown IČO (not billed). Sole traders and undecided forms are refused 404 (not billed); a stock older than 7 days returns 503. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
